Flow.description:
Users must go through this screen flow to upload files in Salesforce. Files do not stay in Salesforce but are moved by the integration tool Informatica to the Advancement Resources SharePoint site. Informatica will use the metadata assigned in this flow to move files to the correct SharePoint folder; it will map the metadata to SharePoint columns so that users can search for files by clicking custom links in Salesforce. See Confirmation_Screen element for the list of custom links.
The flow is launched from one of seven custom buttons:
Constituent: NU_ADV_Upload_from_Constituent Opportunity: NU_ADV_Upload_from_Opportunity Opportunity: NU_ADV_Upload_from_Proposal Designation: NU_ADV_Upload_from_Designation Contact Report: NU_ADV_Upload_from_Contact_Report Constituent: NU_ADV_Upload_Constituent_Research Organization: NU_ADV_Upload_Research_from_Org
Each button passes certain parameters to the flow. In particular, recordObject (the object from which the user is uploading the document) in conjunction with isResearchUpload and isProposalUpload determines the flow's basic path.
The flow must run in a system context because most users don't have sufficient access to the Content Version object.
V8 adds three picklist values (Informational Material; Invitation; Tax Receipt) for Contact Reports.

If the user launches the flow from a constituent, this formula makes the Constituents screen component required, to ensure the user selects at least one associated record. The inverse of this formula is Organization_Required.

The date the custom button set for initialContactReportDate (Contact Report uploads only) or initialCloseDate (booked Opportunity uploads only) 3. Today's date
formulas.name: Default_Date

formulas.description:
The Fund Management department often uploads multiple versions of fund terms or MOUs to a designation. Only one fund terms/MOU is active, but the others are saved for historical reasons. Informatica uses the Current_Version__c checkbox to determine which document is active and append "OLD DO NOT USE" to the beginning of names of old files in SharePoint.
If Fund Management is uploading a document, it's probably the newest version. The Current_Version checkbox screen component should usually be checked by default.
If the user selects Fund Terms or MOU as the document type, deliberately unchecks the Current checkbox because they're uploading a historical version, and then forgets to upload a file, their input should be preserved when they're returned to the input screen. This formula ensures that the Current checkbox is unchecked by default only in that specific circumstance.
formulas.name: defaultCurrent

formulas.description: The File Upload component has an output called File_Upload.contentDocIds that lists the IDs of all the files it uploaded. If it received no files, File_Upload.contentDocIds = [] (an empty collection). If it did receive a file, the output is of course a longer string. This formula calculates the length of File_Upload.contentDocIds; a length of 2 represents the two bracket characters that are the output if no files were received. Therefore, the user uploaded a file if Number_for_File_Count > 2.

Input screen; relies heavily on component visibility. The user only sees 5 or 6 components at first.
The File Upload component uploads files instantaneously. File_Success_Message will appear as soon as the user uploads a file. The user cannot be prevented from uploading multiple files, but the success message warns them against it. If multiple files are uploaded, only the most recent will proceed through the flow and be tagged appropriately.

variables.description:
The associatedRecords variable, mapped to the Associated Records metadata field and ultimately the SFDC Records SharePoint column, should contain a comma-separated list of unique identifiers for all the Salesforce records associated with the document. This is necessary when the custom links search SharePoint.
Three buttons pass in a value for associatedRecords: Constituent: NU ID Opportunity (booked): Opportunity Name Designation: either 6-digit Designation Name or (for placeholder designations) Donor Relations Number
The flow performs secondary steps to populate associatedRecords for contact report documents, research documents, and gift planning documents.
